chars.NARRATOR: a young Moroccan man in his early twenties, short black curly hair, light stubble, wearing a mustard-yellow hoodie, black track pants and white sneakers
chars.FRIEND: a young Moroccan man in his early twenties, buzz cut, thin mustache, wearing a red-and-white striped football jersey and denim shorts
chars.TOURIST: a tall young European man, blond hair in a small man-bun, sunburnt nose, wearing an open turquoise floral short-sleeve shirt over a white tank top and beige shorts

scenes.name: n1.png
scenes.scene: Late afternoon on Essaouira beach, Morocco, the old ramparts and seagulls in the background. TOURIST walks up to NARRATOR holding out a folded wad of Moroccan banknotes with a cheeky grin; NARRATOR, holding a towel, raises his eyebrows in surprise. Both faces clearly visible, medium shot, comic mood.

scenes.name: n2.png
scenes.scene: On the sand near beach towels, TOURIST leans in close and whispers into NARRATOR's ear like a conspirator, one hand on his shoulder; NARRATOR's eyes widen. Essaouira beach, golden light, medium close shot, faces visible.

scenes.name: n3.png
scenes.scene: Close shot: NARRATOR stares open-mouthed at a thick stack of blue Moroccan 200-dirham banknotes that TOURIST is pressing into his hands. Beach background softly blurred, comic shock.

scenes.name: n4.png
scenes.scene: NARRATOR holds the cash up between them and gestures with his other hand palm up in disbelief, as if asking 'all of this?'; TOURIST shrugs and smiles. Essaouira beach at sunset, medium shot, both faces visible.

scenes.name: n5.png
scenes.scene: TOURIST, laughing, spreads his arms wide toward a group of young foreign backpackers sitting on beach towels behind him, as if saying it is for everybody. Essaouira beach, warm sunset light, upbeat mood.

scenes.name: n6.png
scenes.scene: NARRATOR scratches the back of his head, confused, holding the cash; FRIEND next to him grins mischievously and nudges him with an elbow. Essaouira seafront promenade, blue fishing boats behind, medium shot.

scenes.name: n7.png
scenes.scene: NARRATOR sits alone on the low stone wall of the Essaouira ramparts at dusk, elbows on his knees, staring at the cash in his hands, thoughtful and hesitant, old cannons beside him, calm sea behind.

scenes.name: n8.png
scenes.scene: Evening in the narrow white-and-blue alleys of the Essaouira medina: NARRATOR and FRIEND walk fast side by side, looking around suspiciously, NARRATOR with his hand in his hoodie pocket. Warm lantern light, medium shot.

scenes.name: n9.png
scenes.scene: In a dim medina alley at night, NARRATOR holds his phone to his ear calling someone, worried look; FRIEND leans in to listen, also tapping on his own phone. Medium close shot, faces visible, tense but slightly comic.
